description: Peer-to-peer loan proposal between a lender and a borrower. A lender proposes an amount, rate and term to a borrower, who accepts, rejects, or lets it expire; accepted proposals feed the loan and credit-score pipeline.

fields.name: lenderId
fields.description: The client acting as lender for this proposal.

fields.name: borrowerId
fields.description: The client acting as borrower. Same id space as loans.clientId / creditScores.clientId.

fields.name: requestedAmount
fields.description: Principal proposed, in the company currency. Stored as decimal(18,2).

fields.name: proposedRate
fields.description: Annual interest rate percentage offered. Stored as decimal(5,2), e.g. 12.50.

fields.name: status
fields.description: Proposal state. Allowed values: pending, accepted, rejected, expired, cancelled. Defaults to pending on create. FK to loanProposals_status.statusCode.

fields.name: lenderNote
fields.description: Optional note from the lender attached to the proposal or its response.

fields.name: pushNotificationId
fields.description: Links to the push notification raised for this proposal.

fields.name: respondedAt
fields.description: Timestamp set when the borrower accepts or rejects the proposal.

fields.name: expiresAt
fields.description: When the proposal lapses to expired if no response is given.

relationships.notes: Multi-tenant isolation via companyId — injected automatically by stored procedures.
Both lenderId and borrowerId reference clients; a client may take part in many proposals.

components.name: ProposalListStep
components.description: IonList of proposals filtered by companyId, optional lenderId / borrowerId / status. IonSearchbar + IonSelect (status) + infinite scroll. Each row shows amount, rate, term, status badge.

components.name: ProposalFormModal
components.description: IonModal create form: requestedAmount, proposedRate, termMonths, borrower selection, expiresAt, lenderNote.

components.name: ProposalRespondStep
components.description: Accept / reject actions that update status and set respondedAt via sp_loanProposals action 2.
